basedOn: Standard physiology: tissue-specific cellular uptake of absorbed monomers and their oxidation / storage / structural use. A thin teaching stage, not a personal metabolic readout.

uptake.label: Cellular uptake
uptake.detail: Monomers already past the villi and liver enter cells via tissue-specific transporters. Thin teaching stage - not a personal metabolic lab.

oxidizeOrStore.label: Oxidize / store / build
oxidizeOrStore.detail: Fuel to mitochondria (ATP), storage (glycogen/lipid), or structural use (amino acids). Framing only - no fabricated efficiency percentages.

handoff.label: Cellular use closed
handoff.detail: Cellular use is off-lumen. Unabsorbed residue continues as stage.colon in the process sequence.
